Fictional finite-duration income fixture, not a professional valuation.
Valuation date 2024-12-31. Periods end 2025-12-31 and 2026-12-31.
Each supplied equity income is 100 EUR; the separate equity residual at the
second period end is 500 EUR. Effective annual cost of equity is 10%.
Alternative illustrative curve rates are 20% and 30%; they are not benchmarks.
The two-year horizon is a synthetic declared economic-life assumption.
Capital maintenance is assumed covered by the expenses in the income figures.
No incremental reinvestment is assumed; this needs professional assessment.
Distribution availability is a synthetic assumption, not a legal conclusion.
The residual is independently supplied, excludes the period income amounts,
and is already an equity value; no additional debt deduction is intended.
